description: Rail Network - National 250k Map Of Ireland is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tailte Éireann. Rail Network - National 250k Map Of Ireland Railway routes used for regular transportation of goods and passengers. Railway yards, siding railways are allowed if they are landmarks and are classified as branch lines. They are usually generalized (not all the tracks have to be portrayed). Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Tailte Éireann. Its tags are 250K Map of Ireland, dgigovernment. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
